parts.name: Opener
parts.Basic_description: The opener is the front handle and panel assembly of the trashcan, made of stainless steel for durability and ease of cleaning.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to pull open the trashcan drawer to access the bins inside. It provides a grip surface for operation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly outward and inward along the sliding rails when the user pulls or pushes it.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main structural frame of the trashcan, made of powder-coated steel for rigidity and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the internal bins and sliding mechanism, providing stability and housing for the entire trashcan system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation, serving as the fixed support structure.
